data.name: Viresh
data.gender_notes: Viresh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Viresh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vish', which means 'poison'. This name is given to a boy born on a day when the planets are in such alignment that the child is believed to have the power to control poison. This name signifies strength, courage, and the ability to protect oneself and others from harm.
data.spiritual_meaning: Viresh is a name that embodies the divine power of Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. This name is believed to bring protection, strength, and courage to the one who bears it. It is a reminder of the power within each of us to overcome adversity and protect ourselves and those we love.
data.etymology: Viresh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Poison.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Viresh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
